note: Synthetic example of the branch-protection record. The real record is private: monitor/private/branch-protection.json, or CW_BRANCH_PROTECTION. bin/verify-branch-protection.mjs asserts each repo's live required-status-checks are a superset of requiredChecks; bin/commit-provenance.mjs applies unsigned-on-protected-branch only where requireSigned is true. Checks are only ever added here, in lockstep with the platform change that makes them required.
